name: BGMI
description: BGMI (Battlegrounds Mobile India) is an India-exclusive title published by Krafton Inc (KRX/KOSPI: 259960) via Krafton India. Stock price reflects all of Krafton, not BGMI specifically; BGMI-level absolute revenue is not broken out.

stock.note: Reflects Krafton Inc as a whole; down ~32% YoY.

marketing_spend.derivation: Krafton does not break out BGMI India marketing, and BGMI as an individual title is not in PMAR's India top-10. Mobile-gaming publishers typically spend ~10-15% of title revenue on marketing/user acquisition; BGMI drove a 27% paying-user jump via India-exclusive skins and brand collaborations. With a plausible BGMI India revenue base of $150-250M, 10-15% models to ~₹125-300 crore for 2025.

business_updates.headline: Neptune (adtech) to build an India-focused advertising business using BGMI traffic
India-exclusive skins and local brand partnerships drove +27% paying users
Krafton's $150M India-ecosystem pledge; investments include Cashfree ($53M)
